title: Pedestrians to use right half of crosswalks.
bodyText: Pedestrians shall move, whenever practicable, upon the right half of crosswalks.
bodyHtml: [§291C-75]  Pedestrians to use right half of crosswalks. Pedestrians shall move, whenever practicable, upon the right half of crosswalks. [L 1971, c 150, pt of §1]
